summary: Ubisoft and Red Storm's Ghost Recon branch covers squad-focused tactical shooters; this backlog entry adds the distinct PC/console split for Advanced Warfighter.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter
entries.definitive_edition: Owned Windows PC release for PC route; Xbox 360 backward-compatible disc for console route

emulation.notes: Use native Windows compatibility fixes for PC; use Xbox backward compatibility for the console route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Owned PC build at native settings, or Xbox 360 version through official backward compatibility

primary.version: Owned PC release with compatibility fixes
primary.why: The Windows version is a distinct first-person tactical squad route with larger levels and more granular squad command than the console versions. It is not normally sold on current PC storefronts, so archive capture depends on an owned disc or prior digital license.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy with current compatibility fixes. Record source/disc or prior digital license, patch version, renderer/settings, tactical command fix state, mission, squad loadout, difficulty, multiplayer/server availability, and whether the Xbox 360 version was compared.

secondary.platform: Xbox 360 disc on Xbox One / Xbox Series backward compatibility
secondary.exclusive_content: Distinct console design and official current console playback route
secondary.what_to_play: Use for the console version route, especially if PC ownership is unavailable.
secondary.why: The Xbox 360 version differs from PC and is backward compatible, but it is not the same tactical PC build.
They are meaningfully cut-down compared with PC and Xbox 360.

all_releases.fidelity: Distinct high-profile console version with third-person/first-person options and backward compatibility.
all_releases.reason: secondary: important and accessible console route, but not the PC tactical version.

all_releases.fidelity: Lower-fidelity console versions with reduced features.
Distinct first-person tactical PC version with larger levels and squad command focus.
all_releases.reason: primary: best archive route for the PC tactical build.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows and Xbox 360 versions are materially different; archive the PC tactical route and label any Xbox 360 backward-compatible run separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: PC digital availability is poor/delisted; verify ownership, patches, and online dependencies before planning multiplayer.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with DLC and Ubisoft Connect state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with graphics, DLC, and service state documented

primary.version: Current Steam/Ubisoft Connect PC release with DLC state documented
primary.why: Wildlands is a large open-world Ghost Recon entry, and PC is the best capture/settings route for solo or co-op play. Ubisoft Connect/account state, online co-op, Ghost War, DLC, and live-service remnants must be recorded because the game spans offline-ish solo and service-connected features.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release from Steam/Ubisoft Connect. Record storefront, Ubisoft Connect login, build, graphics settings, difficulty/tier mode, squad AI/co-op state, Ghost War availability, Narco Road/Fallen Ghosts DLC, mission region, and any online-service warnings.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console route and couch/party ecosystem context
secondary.why: PC is more flexible for capture and graphics.

all_releases.fidelity: Open-world tactical shooter route, with PC preferred for capture.

all_releases.reason: primary: include or explicitly exclude for complete coverage.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Solo campaign, co-op, PvP, Ubisoft Connect, and DLC state can differ at capture time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record online/co-op/Ghost War service state; do not merge with Ghost Recon Breakpoint.
